Gujarat National Law University
Gandhinagar, Gujarat & Silvassa Campus, UT of DNH & DD
RECRUITMENT ADVERTISEMENT FOR GNLU-SILVASSA CAMPUS
FOR NON-TEACHING POSITION ON DEPUTATION BASIS
(Advertisement Reference No. : GNLU-S/RP-01/2026 Dated 30/10/2026)

Minimum Eligibility Criteria for the Position
Deputy Registrar
1. Essential Qualification & Experience:
Officers holding analogous positions on regular basis in Pay Level 12 or with five years regular
service in Pay Level 11 or with eight years regular service in Pay Level 10 in the Central/ State
Government, Universities and other autonomous Organisations.
Age: The maximum age limit to apply for the post shall be 55 years.
Desirable:
Experience in dealing with General Administration, Establishment Personnel & HR related affairs/
Procurements, experience in dealing with N-Procure and GeM, Stores computer-based Finance &
Accounts/ Audit/ Academics, knowledge of UGC Rules & Regulations, DoPT Rules.
Important Instructions to the Candidates
1. The Candidate selected against the advertisement shall have to work at Gujarat National Law
University (GNLU), Silvassa Campus, Dadra & Nagar Haveli-396230, (DNH&DD), India.
However, as GNLU, Gandhinagar is a headquarter, the selected candidate may be deputed at
GNLU, Gandhinagar campus as and when required.
2. The candidate must ensure his/ her eligibility and other requisite criteria before applying for the
position and then apply.
3. The advertised position is un-reserved as per the norms.
4. The appointment on deputation shall be for a period of three (03) years initially. The period of
deputation may be extended on a year-to-year basis on need basis and performance, subject to a
maximum period of five (05) years tenure, on basis of performance and due approval of
Competent Authority. After Five (05) there shall be no further extension.
5. As mentioned above the position is on deputation basis initially for a period of three (03) years
with full scale including all the benefits i.e. HRA, TA & DA etc. as per the University norms.
6. The review of performance of incumbent appointed will be carried out annually. In case of
unsatisfactory performance the services shall be terminated.
7. The appointment shall give no right to renewal, extension or conversion into permanent
appointment at any stage and shall be put to an end on expiry of tenure.
Page 2 of 3
8. Candidates under the Central/ State Governments/ Universities/ recognised Research
Institutes or Institute of National Importance or Govt. Laboratory or PSUs found eligible must
apply for the position through proper channel alongwith vigilance clearance & attested copy of
last five years ACR/ APARs.
9. Any Vigilance/ Disciplinary / Criminal cases should not be pending/ contemplated against the
entrant working in any Government Organisation/ PSUs. In such cases, the candidature shall
not be considered.
10. The candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law during his/ her entire
career.
11. The character of a person must render him/ her suitable in all respect for the position. Persons
dismissed/ involved in any disciplinary cases by the Union Government or by a State
Government or by a Local Authority or a Government Corporation owned or controlled by
the Central Government or State Government shall be deemed to be ineligible for the position.
12. Candidates shall send their self-attested copies of certificates and mark-sheets from SSC
onwards relevant to the qualifications acquired. Original Certificates should not be sent
alongwith the application form, but must be produced at the time of selection process.
13. Candidates already in Government/ Semi Government/ PSU/ Educational Institution must
send their application through proper channel. However, an advance copy may be sent directly
to the University. In such cases, the candidates called for selection process will have to
produce No Objection certificate as per the prescribed format given in the application form.
Failing which, he/ she shall not be permitted to appear before the selection process.
14. Candidates shall submit the application form as per the prescribed format alongwith recent
passport size photograph affixed thereon. Other than prescribed format/ incomplete
application will not be entertained in any case. Application or resume sent through e-mail/
received after the last date of submission due to Postal delay or any other reason shall not be
considered under any circumstances.
15. The Candidate has to ensure that his/ her application is received by the University within the
stipulated timeframe. No correspondence will be entertained by the University regarding delay
in postal service, not being called for interview or about the result of interview etc.
16. Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.
17. Selected candidate(s) must join the University on the specified date as determined. University
reserves the right not to appoint any selected candidate if he/ she is unable to join by the
designated date.
18. No TA/ DA shall be paid for attending/ participating in the selection process. No shortlisted
candidate(s) shall be considered for selection process after the prescribed date and time for
what so ever the reason.
19. The University reserves the right to alter/ insert any corrections/ additions in the
advertisement/ website (www.gnlus.ac.in) in the event of any typographical error before the last
date prescribed for the receipt of application. In case of any addition/ deletion pertaining to
advertisement, the same shall be published in University website (www.gnlus.ac.in) only.
20. The University shall verify the antecedents submitted by the candidate at any time i.e. at the
time of recruitment or during the tenure of his/ her service. If the given information(s) found
to be incorrect at a later stage or the candidate has a clandestine antecedents/ contextual and
has muffled any information, then his/ her application or service shall be terminated without
notice.
21. Decision of the University authorities in any matter relevant to the advertisement shall be final
and binding.
22. Eligibility of the candidate will be determined on last date of receipt of the application.
23. The University reserves the right not to fill up the vacancy advertised, if the circumstances so
warrant. No personal details/ information regarding candidate(s) shortlisted/ selected shall be
provided to any one at any stage.
Page 3 of 3
24. The application duly filled in all respect alongwith self-attested photocopies of certificates
should reach “The Registrar, Gujarat National Law University, Attalika Avenue,
Knowledge Corridor, Koba, Gandhinagar, Gujarat-382426, India” by 5:00 PM on or
before 30th November 2026 through proper channel by Indian Post i.e. Registered Post or
Speed Post)/ Courier. Submission of application other than the prescribed format will not be
accepted by the University/ taken into consideration.
25. The envelope should be superscribed as “Application for the position of Deputy Registrar
(On Deputation basis) at GNLU-Silvassa Campus”.
26. The University will intimate the eligible shortlisted candidate(s) after the last date of application
through e-mail as provided by the candidate(s) in the application form.
27. Important Dates:
Date of Advertisement 30th October 2026
Last Date to reach Application 30th November 2026 by 5:00 PM
Date of Interview: Detailed Interview schedule will sent to the
Eligible candidates through an Email provided in
the application form as well as the list of the
eligible candidates will be also uploaded on
GNLU official website.
